body: MDXViewer code-fence routing (~lines 276-372) is the bridge from fenced blocks to interactive renderers via className='language-X' + meta string: language-csv->DataBlock, chart->ChartBlock, kanban->KanbanBlock, mermaid->lazy mermaid, sql/prisma/dbml->lazy db-schema-toolkit rendered through Mermaid. HTML custom elements (<callout>/<tabs>/<stats>/<adr>) are lowercased + dispatched via rehype-raw; props arrive as HTML attrs parsed by str/bool/num/list helpers.
